formulas.ebitda: EBITDA = PBT before exceptional items + finance costs + depreciation & amortisation - other income
formulas.ebit: EBIT (operating profit) = PBT before exceptional items + finance costs - other income
formulas.ebitda_margin: EBITDA margin = EBITDA / revenue from operations
formulas.net_debt: Net debt = current + non-current borrowings - (cash & equivalents + other bank balances + current investments); leases excluded
formulas.capital_employed: Capital employed = equity attributable to owners + borrowings
formulas.invested_capital: Invested capital = equity attributable to owners + net debt
formulas.roce: ROCE = EBIT (financial year) / average capital employed (opening and closing balance sheets of that year)
formulas.roic: ROIC = NOPAT / average invested capital; NOPAT = EBIT x (1 - effective tax rate); effective tax rate = tax expense / PBT of the same year (not computed when PBT <= 0 or the rate is outside 0-50%)
formulas.incremental_roic: Incremental ROIC = (NOPAT this year - NOPAT last year) / (invested capital at this year end - invested capital at last year end); not meaningful when invested capital did not rise
formulas.market_cap: Market capitalisation (estimate) = shares outstanding (paid-up equity capital / face value, latest filing) x latest NSE closing price
formulas.revenue_yoy: Revenue growth = latest quarter revenue / same quarter a year earlier - 1 (same reporting basis)

note: Reported panel: values from the company's NSE XBRL filings (TTM = last four quarters) and an estimated market capitalisation (shares from the filing x NSE close). Analyst assumptions are never prefilled: every model input is entered by the analyst with a source note.
